name: Law Enforcement (Vargr)
description: Law enforcement agents typically work for government authorities to uphold the law and prevent crime, but many find work as security guards working for corporations.

investigator.name: Investigator
investigator.description: You are a detective or private investigator.

security.name: Security
security.description: You are part of a private security force.

mishaps.1: Severely injured in action. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: A charismatic criminal under investigation offers you a deal. Accept and you are forced from this career and lose SOC −1. Refuse and you must roll on the Injury table and gain an Enemy.
mishaps.3: An investigation goes critically wrong, ending your career. Roll Advocate 8+. If you succeed you may keep the Benefit roll from this term. If you fail you lose SOC −1.
mishaps.4: A failed investigation forces your pack to find new leadership. Roll SOC 8+ to be on the winning side and remain in this career. If you fail, you leave your pack and career.
mishaps.5: You uncover important information and people want to kill you for it. Gain one Enemy and suffer DM-2 to your next Survival roll if you remain in this career.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: An investigation takes a dangerous turn. Roll Investigate or Streetwise 8+. If you fail, roll on the Mishap table. If you succeed, gain SOC +1 or increase one of the following skills by one level: Deception, Jack-of-All-Trades, Stealth, Streetwise or Tactics (Military).
events.4: You establish a network of contacts. Gain a number of Contacts equal to your SOC modifier (minimum 1).
events.5: You are rewarded for a successful mission. Gain DM+1 to any Benefit roll from this career.
events.6: You are given advanced training. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill you are eligible for in this career.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Vargr Life Events table.
events.8: An investigation uncovers a warehouse full of illegal goods. You may choose to profit from your discovery and roll Deception 8+. If you fail, lose SOC −1 and suffer DM-4 to your next Survival roll. If you succeed, gain one Benefit roll.
events.9: You go undercover to pursue an investigation. Pick another career to use as your cover and roll Deception 8+. If you fail, roll on the Mishap table for that career. If you succeed, roll on any specialist skill table for the chosen career and gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll in this career.
events.10: During a dangerous investigation you save the life of one of your pack members. Gain an Ally.
events.11: Your successes have earned you much respect from your superiors. Gain DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: You solve a big case or uncover a conspiracy against your employers. You are automatically promoted and gain SOC +1.
